areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: One of the most benefited areas: conservation, restoration and carbon-market policies; two indicators; over half of notionally prorated resources; moderate and innovative impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Policies related to climate adaptation and risk reduction; no indicator designed for it; small prorated resource share; subsidiary and reduced impact.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Second most affected area: carbon-market framework, sustainable fuels, green finance; two indicators; about 40% of prorated resources; moderate and innovative impact.

areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: No general or specific objective, indicator or target on health-system strengthening; health adaptation actions are marginal and no resources are allocated to components.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Only one product, on rights of traditional communities to use public forests, bears some relation; no indicators or targets on the theme.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Only indirect links through sustainable agribusiness and land conversion; no indicators or targets; policy-only, little relevant impact.
